[quote=technokratisches_kaiserreich;59958194][b]Angriff auf Shamat[/b]

[i]The Reichswehr had learned many lessons from its engagement with Sikirsk. 

The vast majority of the war had been conducted within the bounds of the Elseyran continentforcing the Kaiserreich to play on the defensive. Even so they had prevailed. 

Now the Reichswehr would pursue a different strategy. 

As THEP and Sikirsk blundered into a fatal trap in Nestorstaat, the Kaiserreich would take the war directly to their homelands. 

THEP had overplayed its hand and now the Kaiserreich saw its opportunity to finally gut its enemies. Permanently.[/i]

[spoiler=[b]Hydronia[/b]] 

[i]In the earlier days of the conflict (https://www.nationstates.net/page=rmb/postid=59924730), the Reichswehr had spotted the mobilization of Hydronia. 

Satellite imagery and OTH had made their movements all too clear and blatant. War was on the horizon and the Kaiserreich could see it. 

In light of this the Kaiserliche Marine (Imperial Navy) would move to dispatch the TKS Seewolf and TKS Seeschlange aircraft carriers and their respective CSGs towards Hydronian waters. 

Now they sat 300 km off the coast waiting for the signal. 

Once the first shots had been fired in Nestorstaat the carrier strike group would waste no time. J-16CJs, J-15Es and EK-18 strike packages patrolling would move to strike. 

The J-16CJs would be the tip of the spear. EW pods aboard the crafts eleven hardpoints would jam and spoof enemy systems to confuse any response. REG-3000 anti-radiation missiles would be deployed from the J-16CJs to suppress enemy anti-air. 

J-15Es, specifically built for air dominance, would be used to defend the strike package from possible air to air engagements at BVR while the EK-18 continually used its electronic warfare capabilities to suppress responses. 

TK-300s move along with the J-16CJs and their strike packages. These aim to not only jam communications across the country but act as decoys for actual aircraft and bait Hydronian radar into activating. Mere seconds of the radars on anti-air systems coming online would result in a LOAL equipped ARM racing towards its location. 

In the skies, to keep the operation going, AWACs and aerial refuelers far behind the line of engagement would continually provide information and fuel. 

Once the decoys, jamming and anti-radiation missiles had properly degraded the Hydronian response capabilities the ruthless bombing campaign would begin. 

A combination of ISR including satellites, unmanned aerial vehicles including the Global Reichsadler and radar would be used to identify targets across Hydronia. 

Command centers, airfields, long-range strike assets, logistic hubs and fuel stores would be the first targets after SEAD had been accomplished. 

Two submarines from the CSGs would move to shallow waters, launch their payloads of a total of 300 Donnerkeil strike missiles and quickly dive back to deeper waters. 

The Donnerkeil maritime strike missile would skim across the water to avoid radar detection. Using their terrain tracking capabilities they would stick close to the ground. Once they approached their targets they would disperse clouds of chaff to confuse any of the enemy radar and increase the chances of interception. 

Destroyers and guided missile cruisers would continue their barrage to pummel Hydronia. The Donnerkeils rise from VLS systems and rocket towards their targets across Hydronia. 

Through usage of the MVSS-130, missile systems are equipped on all sorts of craft, the Kaiserliche Marines firepower expanded exponentially. These systems dont require radar to operate. 

Using decentralized datalink systems the Kaiserliche Marine has become much more efficient than their counterparts. Aircraft sensors and radars aboard ships along with other ISR can independently detect targets. Via secure datalinks this information can be sent to the traditional cruisers and destroyers or transmitted to a MVSS-130. These systems then launch a Donnerkeil to persecute the threat.[/i][/spoiler] 

[spoiler=[b]Bobian Elseyr Exclave[/b]]

[i]Once the first shots were fired in Nestorstaat, the Kaiserliche Marine would declare a full blockade of the Bobian Elseyr Exclave. Along with Ekatanpus, the combined EDU forces would effect a total blockade of the exclave supported by coastal defences placed in the southern Kaiserreich. 

Operation Elseyr Reichsadler would begin. 

The heavily militarized southern province of the Kaiserreich had been built for war. The numerous arms depots, prepositioned stocks, fuel pipelines, oil bladders, forward bases, SSM-300s and others had been built in the decades before. Now the war machine would kick into action. 

J-16CJs and their accompanying strike packages would roar off the runways. Their goal: suppress and destroy Bobian air defenses. The EK-18 electronic warfare craft suppress communications as they fly while spoofing systems at before-visual-range. 

While not affecting physical damage the EK is designed to rapidly decimate the enemies abilities to respond and communicate. The very backbone of modern warfare. 

The J-16CJs fire their payloads of REG-3000 anti-radiation missiles towards enemy radars aiming to blind. These are fired from 250-300 km using before-visual range capabilities. 

TK-300s soar across the Bobian sky as well. Their radar signature mimics that of the J-16CJs, intending to draw enemy fire for two purposes: waste ammunition and allow the REG-3000s to pick up on their locations. At the same time the jamming packages onboard scramble communications for the Bobian military. 

Once the suppression or destruction of the enemies air defenses had been executed, the next stage of the operation would kick in. 

Donnerkeil cruise missiles, flying low to avoid detection, would strike the enemy's command centers. However, most importantly they would also target enemy aircraft in their hangars and runwaysthe advantage of a surprise attack. Precious aviation fuel for the Bobians, now restricted by the blockade, would be slammed by the Donnerkeils. 

J-16s and J-15EX Strike Reichsadlers would move in to engage the remaining enemy aircraft that had survived. At before visual range, supported by aerial refuelers and AWACs they would engage the Bobians at long distance. 

The Gunslinger AAMs would allow them to slam missiles into the Bobian jets while staying well out of their range. Engaging at a maximum distance of 483 km would allow the jets to hit the enemy before they even saw them cominglike shooting fish in a barrel.  

The Kaiserreich would possess another powerful air power advantage. The FAS-3 anti-air system, completely unsuppressed, would pick off Bobian jets. The FAS-3s far longer range would allow it to pursue the enemy's craft and take them down. 

Now the ground strikes would begin. 

J-16CJs would complement the Donnerkeil cruise missiles with JDAMs. These bombs, in the thousands of pounds would slam into a variety of strategic sites. 

Factories, arms depots, bases, command centers, troops, fuel stores and others would be slammed nonstop by Reichswehr air power. 

Naval gunfire would support the air wing as they worked to completely obliterate the Bobians on the ground. Donnerkeils from the destroyers and guided missile cruisers would rain down onto the enemy. 

Hell would rain down on the Bobians from air, land and sea constantly. 

From the Panesan side of the border the Reichswehr troops would watch the gory spectacle. Fire from the heavens themselves appeared to be raining down. The usually peaceful night was violently brokenthe other side of the border had erupted in an inferno punctuated by the roar of jet engines and missiles streaking across the sky. 

Finally when ISR suggested to the Reichswehr that the Bobians had been properly weakened the troops would move across the border. Armored brigades composed of KPz Wotan heavy tanks, infantry fighting vehicles and Strykers would breach frontlines assisted by heavy air support. Three pincers would push the Bobians from all fronts aiming to overwhelm them. 

From behind enemy lines the Airborne Divisions would paratroop and helicopter into enemy territory to capture key airports and allow for rapid deployment.[/i][/spoiler]

[quote=technokratisches_kaiserreich;59954574][spoiler=[b]Operation Seeschlange[/b]]

With the Hydronian, Bobian and Sikirskian fleets massing off the coasts of Nestorstaat, the Reichswehr was watching. 

Hydronia, the Bobians and the Sikirskians had made a fatal mistake. 

Pulling within around 25 kilometres of the coast made them sitting ducks to the vast array of Reichswehr coastal defences. 

However, the Kaiserreich had waited. 

The enemies of the Hochkaiser continued to add to their fatal error as they brought almost nonsensical numbers of aircraft carriers, destroyers and frigates within close range of the entire Reichswehr arsenal. 

Admiral Irkodunsk, Bob City, the Hydronian aircraft carriers could now be hit within almost seconds by the DF-26B. 

Radars marked out the locations and movements of enemy craft as passive sonar marked out the locations of THEP and Sikirskian submarines like Christmas lights. 

But the trap, of THEPs own making, would be sprung once the Hydronians had issued their 10-minute threat. 

Once the threat's time had passed, the Reichswehr would pounce into action. 

Tauschkorper-300 miniature decoys move towards the fleet, their radar signatures mimicking that of aircraft, armed with jamming payloads. 

Their purpose is to draw enemy fire and exhaust the missile defense system of the enemy while scrambling their communications and computer systems. 

At the same time J-16CJs along with their J-15E and EK-18 flight packages would launch massive salvos of REG-3000 anti-radiation missiles towards the fleet. Their LOAL capabilities would be deadly. 

Should enemy radar even turn on for a second to search for incoming missiles, the REG-3000s would lock onto their location. Their light frame and extreme speed would make them extremely hard to intercept as they rocket towards the enemies radars. 

Loitering drones would be used as well. These drones would move in swarms towards the enemy fleet. Completely autonomous with fire and forget capabilities they would be near impossible to jam or use EW against. Once they reached their targets they would dive with their explosive packages onto radars. 

A constant flurry of REG-3000s, jamming, drones and TK-300s would work to drain the enemies missile defences and blind their radars. 

Then the real arsenal would arrive. 

Seeschlange-300s could be launched in the hundreds from Nestorstaat. These supersonic, sea-skimming anti-ship missiles would be near impossible to intercept. Near invisible to radar due to their terrain tracking, they would also be able to maneuver to dodge interceptors while deploying chaff near the ships to confuse enemy radar. 

The chaff, designed by Kaiserreich Maschinenwerke marked a new age in the Kaiserreichs naval capabilities. Designed to mimic the movement of missiles they would make entire clouds of false targets over the ships with the purpose of making the enemy waste precious interceptors and time. 

During the war where the Kaiserreich had forced Sikirsk to withdraw, the Kaiserreich had built up massive arrays of A2/AD capabiltiies. 

Unfortunately for THEP and Sikirsk, the Seeschlange-300s would be the tip of the iceberg. 

Donnerkeil naval strike missiles would arc into the skies. These cheaper and older subsonic cruise missiles, utilizing terrain tracking as well, would purposefully create distractor targets. 

Their purpose is to force THEP and Sikirsk to intercept them and waste their resources. THEP and Sikirsk have a limited supply of interceptorsthey can only utilize what is aboard. The Kaiserreich and allies do not share this issue, Nestorstaat has built up massive supplies of missiles. 

As the massive barrage pours onto the enemy fleet, yet another Kaiserreich card comes into play. 

The DF-26Bs. 

Battle-tested during the earlier conflict, the weapons had proven their worth. 

These carrier killers would target the most valuable enemy capital ships. 

These ballistic missiles would be able to strike the enemy within seconds due to their close proximity to the coast. 

Reentering at mach 8 these weapons would go at extremely fast supersonic speeds, making interception highly improbable. 

However, in the highly improbable scenario that an interceptor would be able to take down such a weapon the DF-26 has multiple cards up its sleeve. 

Due to its MIRV capabilities it is able to split into multiple warheads. This increases the damage it can cause while expanding the number of possible targets. Advanced chaff sprays from it as well, adding to the clouds of chaff above the fleet and further confusing any surviving targeting radar. 

The attack wouldnt let the enemy submarines go either. 

LANCELOT-AR systems had been built specifically to hunt submarines. Passive sonar had painted massive targets on the backs of Bobian, and other submarines. 

Reaching supersonic speeds the missiles after being launched from batteries the missiles would move towards the enemy submarines before deploying multiple torpedoes per missile. These would then hone in on the enemy's submarine and intercept. 

Anti-submarine warfare wouldnt stop at that however. Autonomous submarine systems would be deployed against the enemy subs. These cheap swarms of submarines would be armed with torpedoes. 

Using swarm tactics they would work to overwhelm the enemy with sheer numbers, each autonomous system cheaper to manufacture than the torpedoes used against them. 

The enemy would be forced to deal with smart mines as well. These, laid weeks ago in anticipation of a Sikirskian strike would use acoustic and other signals to detect enemy subs. Laying on the seabed, they would launch torpedoes once they detect an enemy submarine in the vicinity. 

These strikes are carefully planned to maximize penetration. 

The enemies missile and point defense systems(CIWS, C-RAM etc) would be exploited to the maximum. 

Waves would be staggered in 30-60 second intervals so their air defense systems arent allowed to reset. 

The missiles and TK-300s move at different angles and multiple waves to overwhelm systems by forcing them to intercept multiple waves at multiple angles. 

Extremely cheap suicide drones pour out towards the enemy fleet forcing them to burn their ammo. 

THEP and its allies have overplayed their hand. Massive fatal strategic mistakes were made by the combined Hydronian, Bobian and Sikirskian fleets. The Reichswehr isnt afraid to exploit them to inflict massive casualties.[/spoiler]

[quote=bantarus;59955157][i][spoiler]The skies over Nestorstaat were already thick with tension, but as the Reichswehrs defenses came to life, the Jomslandic banner stood firm over the gray waters. From the decks of the SHH Heimaeyja, one of the flagships of the Second Commonwealths naval might, Jarl Svanhild Runarsdottir watched the unfolding operation with a slight smirk.The enemy had moved within range.  And so had they. Arrayed across the coast of Nestorstaat were the combined might of the 6th and 8th Jomslandic Fleets, combat-ready and armed not merely for deterrence but for retribution. Hydronian threats had passed their final warning, and the Commonwealth would not be found wanting. Above the ships, Jomslandic 25x JFH-Velum SFA-23 Orion Maritime Patrol Aircraft circled like ravens over a battlefield, relaying enemy missile trajectories to the entire fleet-wide network. High-atmosphere combat drones, The BD23-HA were already in defensive formation around the Heimaeyja, prepared to intercept hypersonic threats with their own MIRV-capable countermeasures.But it was on land, the coast of Nestorstaat, that Jomslands steel would be felt most viscerally.The Sea Battalion's 20,000 Soldiers had dug in under hardened composite emplacements, shielding mobile surface-to-air missile systems, naval radars, and coast-based cruise missile batteries. 5,000 Jomsvikings , clad in storm-gray armor, now patrolled the coasts and hills, dug into a widespread defense grid. Each man prepared to die on that island, but none intending to. Also moving along the coast are the Úlfhéðnar Special Forces armed with long-range MANPADS, ECM drones, and cutting-edge SIGINT packs. Satellite uplinks streamed data in real-time to command aboard the Heimaeyja, giving Jomslandic naval commanders a full battlefield mosaic. And then, the horizon glimmered. Bright, unnatural, a volley rising from the mainland. The Reichswehrs coastal barrage had begun. TK-300 decoys, REG-3000s, and the first wave of loitering kamikaze drones surged toward the amassed enemy fleet. The Commonwealth fleet shifted seamlessly. The Einherjar-class vessels released their Hvitserk-Class EW drones, forming a mobile jamming web across the fleets perimeter. Hydronian anti-radio seekers would find no target here. Radars went dark, replaced by passive targeting and optical tracking. From the Brimbrjótur-class destroyers, Shieldwall Active Interception Systems began their work. Double-layered intercept protocols, projectile and laser, activated in sequenced defense. Chaff blossoms and directed countermeasures burst from the Rakvélklærnar-class vessels, seeding the sky with false targets and luring missile seekers away. This is Jarl Svanhild aboard the SHH Heimaeyja. All units: Shieldwall Protocol is active. Engage all defensive protocols. Do not fire unless fired upon. But if they dare, make history remember this day. Jomsland had no intention to strike first. But the fleets of Hydronia, Bobia, and Sikirsk had sailed into a trap of their own making. As the Seeschlange-300s thundered from the coast behind them, the Jomslandic fleet held formation, an iron bulwark before the storm. Each vessel ready, each warfighter willing, each radar silent, watching the sky.[/spoiler][/i][nation]United Hydronia[/nation][/quote]
[b]The Battle[/b]
The 10 minutes timer elapsed. The admiral waited. No sign of Jomslandic movement. He was just about to give the order to fire, when a boom was heard, the Kaiserreich had arrived. They knew it would only be a matter of time.

The radars filled up with numbers of aircraft. The Hydronians tried to target them with anti-air missiles, but soon realised that they were decoys. The two aircraft carriers deployed their arsenal of bombers, then quickly began to retreat away from the coast to ensure they took minimal damage. 5 Xowl-6 stealth bombing planes took to the sky and began to rain hell down upon the technocratic fleet as well as a section of their coastal defences, attempting to create an opening.

In order to keep the bombers and the actual fleet safe from the TK missiles, laser systems were used to disrupt the TK missiles guiding systems, sending them in all directions, mostly missing Hydronian assets.

Once a gap had been made in the coastal defences, the enemy had to be distracted. The Hydronians would make a landing at all costs. Suicide drones were deployed to surround and overwhelm the enemy, trying to block their radars and making use of electronic jamming payloads, but with little success due to the already jammed Hydronian systems. 

The Hydronians must resort to missiles. A barrage of missiles were launched from the destroyers, targeted a a select group of TK ships. Once neutralised, this group provided a small opening for a single amphibious assault vessel to get behind enemy lines and speed towards the coast.

Drones and jets continued to circle around the landing site as the amphibious assault vessel arrived. Troops swarmed out of it and thanks to previous satellite observations, the landing site was relatively unmanned, at least compared to other coastal sites. The troops still came under heavy fire. A foothold was quickly established and soon a second and third wave of troops landed, but the forth never came. The forth amphibious assault vessel was sunk by the Jomslandic forces.

At this point in the battle, the 15th fleet arrived from the south, brining an additional 10 ships to the battle. They also came prepared with a helicopter full of paratroopers. These paratroopers landed in the establishment foothold and helped to further reinforce Hydronian positions. From this point, the troops expanded the foothold until they met resistance.

Back in the water, the remaining destroyers and frigates targeted Technocratic and Jomslandic aircraft carriers. With support from the Bobians and Sikirskian, their goal was to neutralise as many ships as possible, to help distract the Elysran forces from the landing they had just made. However this proved difficult due to the Jomslandic swarm of drones and the technocratic barrage of missiles. In the end, the remaining Hydronian forces were forced to retreat back south. They made it look like they had retreated, but they actually waited 500km away for the arenetts to arrive, when they would relaunch their attack.

Operation: Ember Vault
Nestor/North Sea Theater [/b]

Sikirskian forces have now carried out a long-range precision strike on the Technokrat-held island of 'Nestorstaat', targeting key missile storage points, port infrastructure, and logistics hubs. The action was coordinated from beyond the reach of coastal defenses, with no direct risk to the main strike group.

Surface vessels launched a controlled wave of cruise missiles targeting hardened storage depots, handling cranes, fuel lines, and loading corridors. Secondary salvos were launched from forward elements and pre-designated relay zones. Encrypted real-time targeting data was used to coordinate with forward-positioned assets including select SoK aircraft flights, flying low-sea profiles outside detection cones to support targeting without entering direct threat envelopes.

After the strike, all surface groups relocated immediately. No ship remained on original firing coordinates. Minimum repositioning ranged beyond forty kilometers into new vector positions, with broader fallback movement continuing as scheduled. Movement was executed to reduce tracking windows and deny the enemy a reliable counter-strike angle.

Nestorstaats role as the Reichswehrs primary missile stockpile and infrastructure hub has been disrupted. Impact analysis continues. Sikirskian strike elements remained operational and reload commencing when safety secured.
